threshold_origin: Root agent's prospective task-specific engineering requirements, fixed before the new raw mesh was available. These are not a user quality score or a published universal standard.
scope: Geometry-only evaluation. No material generation or student training; GPU remains on.

source_contract.reference_images: User-provided high-quality pickup prior; not hidden or measured a20 ground truth.
source_contract.actor_axes: x forward, y left, z up, metres, centered physical OBB
source_contract.lidar_ownership: Measured points selected by actor OBB and a9 OBB guard; geometric membership proxy, not semantic ground truth. Ground or other-object contamination remains possible. All 1030 points stay in the primary metric.

layer_1_prior_structure.method: Independent actual inspection of fixed geometry-only views, with connected-component and spatial evidence. Structural failure overrides any numerical pass.
required: Coherent nose/grille, cabin, cargo bed/tailgate and bumpers; no semantic front/rear reversal.
Four discernible wheels in a two-axle arrangement, coherent left/right wheel positions and wheel/body relations.
Plausible wheel contact and underbody clearance; report wheel-bottom mismatch and measured proxy-ground offset where identifiable.
No unexplained floating roof or mirror blobs, detached panels, or major part-connection defects.
No use of complete mesh, alpha, or texture availability as structural acceptance.
layer_1_prior_structure.note: Disconnected components can be legitimate tires or mirrors; component count alone is not a pass/fail rule. Structural observations must identify parts and defects.

layer_2_a20_adaptation.iou_definition: |M intersect V| / (|V| + |M intersect B|), unknown U excluded
layer_2_a20_adaptation.spill_definition: |M intersect reliable B| / |M| within the frozen crop
layer_2_a20_adaptation.point_metric_definition: Exact Euclidean point-to-triangle distances, not LiDAR ray-depth residuals.
layer_2_a20_adaptation.mask_uncertainty: Frozen visible cores derive from approximate 480x320 masks with conservative erosion, nearest-expanded to native image size. Unknown/occluded potential is not amodal silhouette GT.

coordinates_and_size.heading: Determine signs using visible nose/grille versus cargo bed/tailgate in raw mesh views. Never infer forward merely from the longest axis or LiDAR fit.
coordinates_and_size.allowed_initialization: One proper rotation from semantic axis mapping, one uniform scale from known 5m longitudinal size, and centering. Keep raw aspect ratios and report them before initialization.
coordinates_and_size.forbidden: Independent XYZ scaling to force known dimensions.
coordinates_and_size.required_records: Raw mesh and its SHA256, raw extents, semantic proper-rotation matrix, uniform scale and translation, forward/inverse 4x4 matrices, initialized mesh and every derived registered mesh.
coordinates_and_size.dimension_note: Longitudinal extent becomes 5m by construction; this is a size initialization, not evidence of generated physical accuracy. Width and height ratios remain independently informative.

optional_registration.objective: Single bounded robust point-to-surface rigid-yaw and uniform-scale fit; no seed, orientation or threshold sweep.
optional_registration.disclosure: Registered 86/110 metrics are fitting-set metrics, not independent generalization evidence. The unregistered uniform initialization remains a separate reported result.

visible_observation_protection.requirements: A future teacher-to-student path must lock genuine visible geometry/RGB with auditable correspondence and confine generation to unknown completion regions.
